name: John K Jonak
office: Regional Superintendent of Schools, Kane County

items.text: John K. Jonak was appointed Kane County Regional Superintendent in July 2025. His office oversees professional development, school safety, and truancy support for nine districts. His office launched "The ROE Link" video series to connect families with county services.
